    BAR_Y = 2.2  # Positioned above glass surface to avoid collision
    BAR_H = 0.24  # Height of each sweeping bar

    DENSITY = 1.0  # Density for mass calculation
    BAR_FRICTION = 0.8  # High friction for effective particle removal

    # Define bar positions to cover full 12m length without exceeding build zone
    seg_centers = [1.0, 3.0, 5.0, 7.0, 9.0, 11.0]
    bars = []

    base = sandbox.add_beam(
        x=CENTER_X, y=2.08, width=0.5, height=0.12, angle=0, density=DENSITY
    )

        sandbox.set_material_properties(b, restitution=0.0, friction=BAR_FRICTION)
        bars.append(b)

    # Sustained sweeping motion with optimized torque
